+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("maximum", "tlp", "allowed"),
+    [
+        ("clear", "TLP:CLEAR", True),
+        ("clear", "TLP:GREEN", False),
+        ("amber+strict", "TLP:AMBER+STRICT", True),
+        ("amber+strict", "TLP:RED", False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_submission_respects_the_configured_tlp_ceiling(maximum, tlp, allowed):
+    connector = _connector({"max_tlp_level_for_submission": maximum})
+    connector.helper.check_max_tlp = OpenCTIConnectorHelper.check_max_tlp
+    connector.tlp = tlp
+    connector.client.get_domain_scans.return_value = []
+    connector.client.submit_scan.return_value = "fresh"
+    connector.client.wait_for_scan.return_value = True
+
+    scan_id = connector._resolve_scan_id("https://example.com/")
+
+    if allowed:
+        assert scan_id == "fresh"
+        connector.client.submit_scan.assert_called_once_with(
+            "https://example.com/", scan_type="public"
+        )
+        connector.client.wait_for_scan.assert_called_once()
+    else:
+        assert scan_id is None
+        connector.client.submit_scan.assert_not_called()
+        connector.client.wait_for_scan.assert_not_called()
